evaluation.rationale: The dialogue and camera work create immediate tension and emotional impact, but the setup is slow, and the cliffhanger is not fully resolved.
evaluation.hook_evidence: "I knew I had seen those eyes before." The disgraced daughter... the girl thrown out of her own family home.
evaluation.cliffhanger_evidence: Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers. And this? This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate.
